title: Rights clearance decisions for the 8,444 rights-pending catalog texts
scope: Distinct full texts in the local v0.2.7 all-data catalog that appear in no public v0.2.7 config (exact NFKC/casefold/whitespace match).
jurisdiction_rule: Release requires public-domain status, a compatible license, or written permission in both India (source country) and the United States (Hugging Face hosting). India-only public domain is listed separately for an owner decision.
status_note: No public data changed. Tier A decisions are evidence-complete and await owner sign-off before they are wired into the builders and released.

sources.work: H. G. Walton, British Garhwal: A Gazetteer (District Gazetteers of the United Provinces, vol. XXXVI), Government Press, Allahabad, 1910
sources.basis: India: Government work, Copyright Act 1957 s.28 term of 60 years from publication ended 1970 (same basis the project already applies to Walton scan pages 90-91). US: published 1910, before 1931.
sources.edition_check: Local scan title page reads Volume XXXVI, H. G. Walton, I.C.S., Allahabad, 1910.

sources.work: R. Strachey, rev. J. F. Duthie, Catalogue of the Plants of Kumaon and of the Adjacent Portions of Garhwal and Tibet, Lovell Reeve, London, 1906
sources.basis: Last surviving author J. F. Duthie died 23 Feb 1922; Strachey died 1908. India: life+50 term then in force ended 31 Dec 1972, before the 1992 extension (which did not revive expired terms). UK: life+70 ended 1992. US: published 1906.
sources.edition_check: Local scan title page matches the 1906 Strachey/Duthie revision.

sources.work: E. Sherman Oakley, Holy Himalaya, Oliphant Anderson & Ferrier, Edinburgh, 1905
sources.basis: Author died at Ranikhet in 1934 or 1935. India: life+50 term ended by 31 Dec 1985. UK: life+70 ended by 2005. US: published 1905.
sources.edition_check: Local OCR is the 1905 first edition (Archive item holyhimalayareli00oaklrich); no later-edition markers found.

sources.work: C. A. Sherring, Notes on the Bhotias of Almora and British Garhwal, Memoirs of the Asiatic Society of Bengal vol. I no. 8, Calcutta, 1906
sources.basis: Author identified from the scan's title page (catalog record currently says 'not identified'). Sherring died 8 Oct 1940. India: life+50 term ended 31 Dec 1990, before the 1992 extension. UK: life+70 ended 2010. US: published 1906. The Archive uploader's CC BY-NC 4.0 label applies to the scan, not to the 1906 text.
sources.edition_check: Local scan page 1 reads Memoirs ASB vol. I no. 8, C. A. Sherring, Calcutta, 1906. Correct the catalog author and year (1906, not 1905).

sources.work: Rai Pati Ram Bahadur, Garhwal: Ancient and Modern, Army Press, Simla, 1916
sources.basis: US: published 1916, public domain. India: public domain now if the author died before 1966; no death date found yet. The book also has an introduction by another writer whose identity and dates need the same check.

sources.work: Rai Bahadur Dharmanand Joshi, Notes on the Garhwal District, Indian Press, Allahabad, 1910
sources.basis: US: published 1910, public domain. India: public domain now if the author died before 1966; no death date found yet.

sources.work: E. S. Oakley and T. D. Gairola, Himalayan Folklore (1935; scan is the 1977 Bibliotheca Himalayica reprint)
sources.basis: Oakley died 1934/35. Gairola died 28 May 1940 per Wikipedia/Wikidata, or 28 May 1950 per a regional literature article. If 1940: public domain in India (term ended 1990) and the US (public domain at home on 1 Jan 1996, so no URAA restoration). If 1950: public domain in India since 2011 but protected in the US until end 2030. Either way, the 1977 reprint's added introduction is a separate in-copyright layer, so those pages must be excluded.

sources.work: Rahul Sankrityayan, Himalaya Parichay vol. 1: Garhwal, 1953
sources.basis: Author died 14 Apr 1963: public domain in India since 1 Jan 2024. In the US, restored under the URAA (still protected in India on 1 Jan 1996), so protected until the end of 2048.

sources.work: Mahidhar Sharma Barthwal, Garhwal Me Kon Kahan Se, 1938
sources.basis: The Archive public-domain mark is unverified. India: public domain if the author died before 1966. US: public domain only if it was already public domain in India on 1 Jan 1996, which requires death before 1946. No death date found.

sources.work: Uttarakhand Open University study material (CGL, MAHL modules)
sources.basis: Site declares CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, but the modules quote copyrighted Garhwali poems and prose by other authors, which UOU cannot license. Pages dominated by quoted literary works must be screened out; the rest can go into a noncommercial/share-alike config like HinDialect.
